gaps: Coverage limit: the shared web-search allowance for this run was used up after 13 searches, so this sweep could not be run market by market. Rows after that point come from direct reads of filings, association board pages and news pages. The sweep should be re-run with search available; expect 40+ more division presidents to be findable.

Region presidents: not named in the FY2026 10-K (filed 2026-11-18), which says only that each region president oversees several of the 92 homebuilding divisions and reviews and approves all land and lot acquisition contracts, with corporate approving and funding. No company page or press release naming a current region president was found; the three regional names in this file are unconfirmed aggregator leads.
Reporting lines: who each region president reports to is not stated publicly (likely the Chief Operating Officer); no division-to-region assignment is published.

Region- and division-level vice presidents or directors of land acquisition, land development or entitlement: none confirmed by name. Job postings show the title 'Division Vice President (DVP) of Land' exists (for example Charleston, SC) but name no one.

Northwest region, no leader found: Colorado (Colorado Springs, Denver, Fort Collins), Idaho (Coeur d'Alene), Oregon (Bend, Eugene/Springfield, Medford, Portland/Salem), Utah (Salt Lake City/Provo/Ogden, St. George), Washington (Bremerton, Central Washington, Seattle/Tacoma/Everett/Olympia, Spokane, Vancouver).

Southwest region, no leader found: Arizona (Tucson), California (all nine markets), Hawaii (Oahu), Nevada (Las Vegas; Reno division president), New Mexico (Albuquerque, Santa Fe). Phoenix is the only market with a named division president.

South Central region, no leader found: Arkansas, Louisiana, Oklahoma and all 14 Texas markets (Abilene, Austin, Beaumont, Bryan/College Station, Corpus Christi, Dallas, East Texas, Fort Worth, Houston, Killeen/Temple/Waco, Lubbock, Midland/Odessa, New Braunfels/San Marcos, San Antonio).
Southeast region, no leader found: Alabama (6 markets), Florida (15 markets), Mississippi (3 markets), Tennessee (5 markets).
East region, no leader found: Georgia (5 markets), North Carolina (6 markets), South Carolina (5 markets).

North region, no leader found: Delaware, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas/Missouri, Kentucky, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota (division president; two land managers are named), Nebraska, Ohio (Columbus is an unconfirmed lead; Cincinnati/Dayton none), Pennsylvania, Virginia (Northern Virginia, Virginia Beach/Williamsburg, Western Virginia), West Virginia, Wisconsin. New Jersey and southern Virginia (Richmond) have named heads.
